unit.why: The division is a mnemonic teaching: it derives the laws of Hanukkah from the initials of the verse 'כף אחת עשרה זהב מלאה קטורת'. It closes with a blessing formula and has no narrative event.
unit.boundary_note: Seems to continue the sayings at the end of the previous division and closes a section; the next division opens a new story about one of the 36 hidden righteous.
